priorAuditAccountingReconciliation.explanation: The confirmation audit's fork queried only the window 15:15-15:25 UTC on 2026-08-19, which captures runs 37e87046 (first invocation 15:16:01) and 92a892fc (15:20:15) but NOT run a3c9692d (2026-08-18 19:35:00, the prior calendar day) -- that is the entire count discrepancy (8 vs 12). Separately, and independent of the window, the audit's own text says it computed cost as 'sum of all 16 AIInteraction rows' in that window -- i.e. it deduplicated correctly for the INVOCATION COUNT (16 raw rows -> 8 distinct, matching generationCorrelationId pairs) but did NOT deduplicate for the COST figure (summed all 16 raw rows, double-counting each of the 8 distinct invocations once for each of its 2 duplicate rows, from the pre-fix double-write bug). Both numbers below are computed directly from the same per-run costUSD figures recorded in this file's runs[] array.
priorAuditAccountingReconciliation.priorRawRowCostSumArithmetic: 2 * (0.00128025 + 0.00133965) = 2 * 0.0026199 = 0.0052398 -- matches the audit's reported '≈0.0052' to the precision it stated
priorAuditAccountingReconciliation.priorDeduplicatedCostArithmetic: 0.00128025 (run 37e87046) + 0.00133965 (run 92a892fc) = 0.0026199 -- what the audit's own window should have reported had it deduplicated cost the same way it deduplicated the invocation count
priorAuditAccountingReconciliation.currentRawRowCostSumArithmetic: 2 * 0.00395115 = 0.0079023 -- the undeduplicated total across all 24 raw rows this session, for comparison only; not a real spend figure
priorAuditAccountingReconciliation.currentDeduplicatedProviderCostArithmeti: 0.00133125 (run a3c9692d) + 0.00128025 (run 37e87046) + 0.00133965 (run 92a892fc) = 0.00395115 -- the true total real provider spend across the full session, each invocation counted exactly once

method: SELECT-only query of AIInteraction (route='curriculum.waecBaselineAlignment', requestType='p2c_live_ai_sme_proof') and count of AiInteractionLog rows with the same endpoint/requestType, on staging (yonpfzjczoffhrgibxkz), no rows deleted or mutated.
duplicationMechanism: Prior to the interactionLog.ts idempotency fix in this closure pass, routedCompletion() logged internally via logAIInteraction() (awaited/durable whenever feature==='curriculum' && provenanceWritersEnabled(), true on staging) AND scripts/p2c-live-ai-sme-proof.ts called logAIInteraction() a second time itself (also durable: true) using the same generationCorrelationId, as a defensive measure against routedCompletion's internal write being fire-and-forget in non-curriculum/non-provenance contexts. Both calls unconditionally created a new row with no dedup guard, so every real invocation was persisted twice in AIInteraction and, when the second call also went on to write AiInteractionLog, twice there too. Fixed in this pass: logAIInteraction() now looks up an existing AIInteraction row by generationCorrelationId before creating one, and only writes the legacy AiInteractionLog row when it is actually creating a new canonical AIInteraction row. See lib/ai/interactionLog.ts and __tests__/ai.interactionLog.test.ts (dedup describe block).
